sources.title: Download Models - Stanza
sources.snippet: Stanza provides pretrained NLP models for a total 70 human languages. On this page we provide detailed information on how to download these models to process text in a language of your choosing. Automatic download Pretrained models in Stanza can be divided into four categories, based on the datasets they were trained on: Universal Dependencies (UD) models, which are trained on the UD treebanks ...
